title: Message timestamps
description: There are no timestamps on messages currently. Adding relative times ("2m ago") or hover-to-see-absolute-time would help track conversation flow.

title: Markdown rendering
description: Assistant messages are rendered as plain text. Claude outputs markdown (code blocks, headers, lists, bold) — rendering it properly would massively improve readability.

title: Search/filter messages
description: Long conversations are impossible to navigate. A Cmd+F style search bar to filter messages by content or tool name would help.

title: Syntax highlighting in tool calls
description: Control request cards show raw JSON in a plain <code> block. Syntax highlighting (or at minimum, pretty-printing with indentation) would make tool approval much easier.

title: Streaming text display
description: Currently messages appear all at once after processing. Showing text as it streams in would make the UI feel much more responsive.

title: Multi-pane / split view
description: You can only see one agent at a time. Side-by-side or tabbed views would let you monitor multiple agents working in parallel.

title: Copy message button
description: No way to copy a message's content. A small copy icon on hover would be useful.

title: Keyboard shortcuts
description: No keyboard shortcuts for common actions (send on Enter, switch agents with Ctrl+1/2/3, approve/deny tool calls).

title: Auto-scroll toggle
description: The auto-scroll behavior could be annoying when reading history. A "pin to bottom" toggle that disables when you scroll up and shows a "jump to bottom" button.

title: Message export
description: Export a conversation as markdown or JSON for sharing or documentation.

title: Tool call result previews
description: Condensed tool groups tell you what was called but not the results. Showing truncated output inline would add context.

title: Agent cost/duration summary
description: The result message has cost data. A small summary card at the top showing total cost, duration, and turn count per agent.

title: Connection status toast
description: WebSocket reconnection happens silently. A brief toast notification when connection drops/restores would build trust.

title: Empty state
description: When no agent is selected, the chat area is blank. A nice empty state with quick-start instructions would help.

title: Resizable sidebar
description: The sidebar width is fixed. A drag handle to resize would let users optimize their layout.
